set.body:
Reproduced from exact ScalaFIM fd992a0c85001eb50ba2e78d29c497693ca494dc plus Intaglio 38e8c62b5b3fb74d0a32664a168e95e9f708bd49 in the PLS Neuro isolated consumer. DesignGraphics.scala:59 names the now-generic DiscreteDomain without a type argument, causing a kind mismatch. Its caller only requires validated ordered regressor levels.
Scope: Refine the private helper to return exactly those levels through public Intaglio domain training, keeping errors and ordering intact and avoiding casts or app-specific branches. Preserve compatibility with the existing pinned Intaglio as well as the candidate version.
Acceptance: design JVM and JS focused graphics tests pass for the exact candidate, existing pin compiles/tests where applicable, and the downstream consumer progresses beyond this failure. Record exact patch provenance. Original shared worktree edits outside this source remain untouched. Downstream issue: plsneuro/.mote bd-01M1SATX8Q3Y8JM895MHFA04PW (provenance only).
set.title: Keep DesignGraphics regressor levels compatible with typed Intaglio domains
